title: Alert fatigue analysis
description: Identifies noisy, low-value alerts that contribute to alert fatigue and reduce team responsiveness.
example_prompt: "Analyze all alert rules that fired in the last 30 days. Identify: (1) alerts that fired > 50 times, (2) alerts that auto-resolved within 5 minutes > 80% of the time, (3) alerts where no action was taken (no comments, no state change). Recommend suppression, threshold adjustment, or consolidation."
